outside.rule: registered arms that are not in the subset of the paper pass (make_2611_stages.OUTSIDE)

neo4j-memgraph-dense.why: Neo4j and Memgraph stay in the graph lane (and cross-model where they are); their dense-lane cells are out

quantized-dense.why: the dense lane is fp32 only: quantized arms are not like-for-like across engines, and quantization is out of the paper's scope (ArcadeDB's own INT8 and BINARY are out by the owner's rule; jvector PQ, BQ and NVQ are studied after the paper)

second-list.why: sparse, time series and lifecycle are out of scope for the paper (the comparators and the ArcadeDB chain alike)
